entities.summary: Alan Keith Branch is an American former professional football player who was a defensive tackle in the National Football League (NFL). He played college football for the Michigan Wolverines and was selected by the Arizona Cardinals in the second round of the 2007 NFL draft. He also played in the NFL for the Seattle Seahawks, Buffalo Bills, and New England Patriots.
